coverage.endExclusiveRule: 00:00:00Z immediately following the latest UTC day fully completed at acquisition time

rawDataRequirement.partitioning: One atomic, content-addressed, sealed partition directory per archive month or REST day; never overwrite.
rawDataRequirement.manifestCreationGate: Create each manifest only after full coverage is acquired and validated.

split.holdoutRule: Never perform strategy, signal, trade, candidate, optimization, or metric calculations on holdout; raw integrity validation only is permitted.

validation.admission: Fail closed on invalid or unresolved data; never fill gaps.
